fields.label: Partner ID
fields.description: External partner identifier for the partner company.

fields.label: Partner Status
fields.description: Lifecycle status of the partner company.

fields.label: Partner Tier
fields.description: Program tier assigned to the partner company.

fields.label: Partner Region
fields.description: Region assigned to the partner company.

fields.label: Partner Capacity
fields.description: Capacity score or count used to route partner work.

fields.label: Onboarding Status
fields.description: Current onboarding status for the partner company.

fields.label: Program Start Date
fields.description: Date when the partner program relationship starts.

fields.label: Program End Date
fields.description: Date when the partner program relationship ends.

fields.label: MDF Annual Budget
fields.description: Annual MDF budget allocated to the partner company.

fields.label: MDF Used
fields.description: MDF budget amount already approved or used by the partner company.

fields.label: MDF Available Budget
fields.description: Remaining MDF budget available to the partner company.

fields.label: Assigned Channel Manager
fields.description: Internal channel manager assigned to the partner company.

fields.label: Primary Partner Admin Contact
fields.description: Primary partner administrator contact for the account.

fields.label: Is Partner
fields.description: Indicates whether the account represents a partner company.
